exposure: VBAC vs. normal spontaneous vaginal delivery (NSVD)
First-time mothers who gave birth naturally
cohort: 71 women with a previous caesarean section who had a second birth (VBAC group) and 583 women who had normal spontaneous vaginal delivery (NSVD group) as a control
finding: Severe maternal and neonatal complications were infrequent in women who had a VBAC compared to those who had a NSVD.
mod_finding: Women who had a VBAC had longer labor duration, higher episiotomy rates, and higher epidural analgesia rates compared to first-time mothers who gave birth naturally.
